name: Set Trap
description:
You place and conceal one of your traps in an unoccupied adjacent space. Roll Craft to set the trap's Difficulty.

When a creature enters the trap's space, the trap springs and the creature rolls Awareness against the Difficulty. On a failure, choose two different trap effects (defined in the Trapper trait). On a pass, choose one trap effect.

When you set the trap, each creature within short range that can see you learns the location of the trap, unless you roll Stealth vs Awareness against them. On each win, that creature does not learn the location of the trap.

Describe how you set your trap.

improvements.name: Throw Trap
improvements.description: Instead of setting your trap in a fixed location, you may set it and hold it at the ready, using both hands. While you are doing so, when a creature moves within short range of you, you may spend a reaction to throw the trap in its path. Roll Dexterity vs Awareness against the creature. On a win, choose one of your trap's effects.
